note: Pinned vendor source for the ROCm backend. ROCm 10.1 is the only verified toolchain (userland, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1); 6.4 (early probe) and 7.7 (original target) are historical.

primary.comment: The wheel builds from the fetched pinned tree (the repo root is the buildable `pip wheel .` source with the ROCm backend grafted in); the pin must resolve in the fork and `scripts/build-wheel.sh` fails loud otherwise. The committed vendor/mlx-rocm-upstream/ tree is a byte-verified PARTIAL reference snapshot — NOT the build input: it carries no build manifest (no setup.py/pyproject of its own, CMakeLists preserved as CMakeLists.upstream.txt, python/ holds only src/fast.cpp, no tests/). Slice 3340 (b)+(c) publish: (b) S4VA default-ON qL==4 one-line (the T3336 lever at the 27B shape: hidden 5120 / kv ctx 4096 / vocab 248320; the read-once env gate default flips to ON, the escape hatch MLX_ROCM_SDPA_S4VA=0 stays reachable) + (c) int2w K-gen K 4096->5120 (the K = 5120 / NG = 40 16-lane-group kernel + the PI128 __constant__ table for the ROCm 7.2 clang mis-compile + the K-gate 4096/32 -> 5120/40, 5 chunks / 20.48 KB LDS / 2 blocks/CU; the kernel region byte-identical to the T3339 validated delta). See docs/quickstart.md.

build.comment: RX 9070 XT is gfx1201 (RDNA4), NOT gfx110x. ROCm 10.1 userland (amdrocm-*-dev10.1, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1) provides hip/rocblas/rocprim/hiprand/hiprtc/hipblaslt/rocwmma; pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/rocm/core-10.1 (see docs/quickstart.md).
